card.name: Ending of comparative 'as/most' phrases
card.fires_on: The last word of a set comparison or superlative phrase, such as 'ever before in history', 'as rapidly as practicable', 'as you can get', 'as you like'. It fires where the phrase is about to close.

modes.label: Superlative endings
modes.description: Final word of a 'most ever' or 'largest of its kind' phrase.

modes.label: As...as phrases
modes.description: Closing word of an 'as X as you can/like/practicable' construction.
modes.example: as rapidly as pract<<icable>> to achieve optimum therapeutic control.

card.plain: It marks the point where a stock comparison phrase like 'as easy as you like' or 'ever before in history' is ending.
